name: An entity
title: One entity, *and a whole CRUD*
lede: We write a Post entity and the handler that serves its rows, then start the app with npx fougere dev blog. It answers on port 4100 and keeps the rows in memory.
fig: Two classes and one line of config. Everything around them is read from these.

grows.label: 5 REST routes under /api/blog/posts
grows.detail: one per operation — because protocols: names rest. npx fougere explain lists them

grows.label: type Post
grows.detail: in the page's client, typed down to its refusals

grows.label: validation
grows.detail: title required, 160 at most — the same rule on the server and in the browser

grows.detail: a form's fields and state, nothing to declare again
